On sparse montages (d≤19d \le 19d≤19), correlation models drop -5.25 pp below BatchNorm (56.88% vs 62.13%) because unit-diagonal normalization erases channel bandpower.

CLAIM 3B · HIGH-DENSITY EEG (d∈[56,64]d \in [56, 64]d∈[56,64])11 Datasets

On high-density montages (56–6456\text{--}6456–64 channels), foundational spatiotemporal filterbanks (TSMNet, EEGSPDNet, Green) rank #1 at 64.45% by isolating focal cortical sources before covariance pooling.
